scope: R3.1 quantiser design only; no ECC or BSC draws
repeat_choice: Five independent full two-second design records per SNR, 40 total; no claim of held-out whole-system validation or guaranteed statistical precision
envelope_reason: Use one quantiser for both future filter/code comparisons, covering the existing -10 to 40 dB stress/diagnostic envelope as well as the personal point; this broadens quantiser headroom, not the R2 filter design claim
headroom_reason: Declared conservative six-sigma marginal Gaussian headroom, rounded upwards to an integer original-amplitude unit; a union bound is reported, not a zero-overload guarantee
rounding: numpy.round, including its ties-to-even behaviour after the reference epsilon shift
range_handling: Fixed A, clip samples to [-A,A] before normalising; clip final labels to [0,2**B-1]; count original-input overload
budget_definition: mean((U(z_q)-U(z))**2) / mean((U(z)-reference)**2) <= 0.01 on every design record and branch
budget_reason: Project engineering tolerance: quantisation error power is at most one hundredth of the existing upstream error power on the measured envelope, while minimising bit cost; not a external threshold or a 1% bound on total MSE
selection: Smallest candidate B satisfying the component budget and zero observed overload on all 80 branch records; fail explicitly if no candidate passes
bit_order: unsigned natural binary, MSB first, sample-major
channel_control: p=0 by identity transport; do not instantiate the BSC or parameter leaf (0,1)
future_validation: All choices use R3 phase 0; R3 phase 1 and study 4 remain unused for later independent coding/full-system validation
